choices: In this study, you will read short podcast turns and judge whether a specific assumption is likely held by the speaker based only on that turn. There are no right answers—use your best judgment.
• Questions: Yes/Unsure/No, an optional evidence quote, your confidence (1–5), and cue checkboxes.
The task takes a few minutes depending on items. Risks are minimal and similar to reading online text. Some content may express strong opinions or religious viewpoints.
